Commentary.Commentary: That's all we have from this game which saw Zimbabwe getting eliminated and the Netherlands who were already out, claiming a comprehensive win. However, you do not need to go too far away as India and Bangladesh have arrived at the Adelaide Oval. The game begins at 1.30 pm IST (8.00 am GMT). Do switch tabs and get all the updates. Cheers!
Max O'Dowd has been adjudged the PLAYER OF THE MATCH for his outstanding effort with the bat. He scored 52 runs in 47 deliveries which included 8 fours and one maximum.

The onus of this loss lies with the Zimbabwean batters who never got going and posted a poor total on the board. Barring Sean Williams and Sikandar Raza, none of the other players were able to get into double figures and that should be a real worry for the team as all the burden of scoring runs falls on their two stalwarts. The Dutch put on a complete bowling performance with all their fast bowlers among the wickets. Paul van Meekeren claimed three and Brandon Glover, Bas de Leede, and Logan van Beek chipped in with two each. Their effort restricted their opponents to under 120 and the batters completed the formality.

Zimbabwe picked up their performance towards the end of the game but had a very disappointing outing on the field. They have lost their opportunity of making it to the semi-finals and they will know their fate was in their own hands. They did get an early wicket with Blessing Muzarabani carrying forward his good form but they fell off and lacked discipline through the middle overs. In the end, Richard Ngarava and Blessing Muzarabani did end up with two wickets each with Luke Jongwe claiming one but their effort was in vain as they succumbed to a disappointing defeat.

The Netherlands got off to a shaky start as they lost Stephan Myburgh early but a 73-run partnership between Max O'Dowd and Tom Cooper set them up for an easy run chase. Max O'Dowd reached his half-century and looked like he would take his team home but he was dismissed and 4 wickets for 30 runs towards the end showed where their weakness lies. The target was no under-par and that allowed them to overcome the stutter and seal a comfortable win.

A flurry of wickets along with plenty of dots at the end for Zimbabwe and how they would have been hoping for this at the start of the inning! Despite the finish, this has been a walk in the park for the Netherlands as they have managed to win with five wickets in hand and with 2 overs to spare! They pick up their first win of the Super 12 stage and they will be really proud of their effort even so knowing that they are now responsible for eliminating Zimbabwe from this tournament.
FOUR! Bas de Leede finally gets this one away! Slightly shorter and on off, Bas de Leede shuffles across and thumps it over mid on for a boundary. Netherlands win by 5 wickets!
Play and a miss. Five dots now! Fuller and outside off, Bas de Leede looks to play at it but misses.
Fuller and on off, Bas de Leede knocks it but finds the fielder at mid off. Dot again!
Another one outside off, Bas de Leede eases it to the cover fielder.

Slightly shorter and outside off, Bas de Leede moves forward to play at it but misses. The keeper fails to grab it and missed a stumping. Bas de Leede was walking off the ground but turns back in and is safe. Lucky escape!
Tossed up, on leg. Bas de Leede defends it back towards the bowler.
On a length and outside off, Roelof van der Merwe looks to play at it but misses again. Still, 2 needed!
Another outswinger just outside off, Roelof van der Merwe looks to defend it but gets beaten off the outside edge. Close!
On a length and on leg, Roelof van der Merwe defends it to mid on.
Roelof van der Merwe is the new batter out in the middle.

OUT! EDGED AND TAKEN! A sudden burst of wickets for Zimbabwe as the Dutch are making tall work of a routine chase. Shorter and on off, Scott Edwards looks to pull it and finish off in style, he gets the slightest of the edge and Regis Chakabva does the rest behind the stumps. The Netherlands still need two runs to win!
Commentary.Howout: c Regis Chakabva b Richard Ngarava

Commentary.Commentary: Good length shaping it away from the batter, Scott Edwards looks to defend it but misses.
Bowls it on a length and just outside off, Bas de Leede taps it to short covers for a quick single. 2 runs needed now!
Keeps it bowling on a length, Scott Edwards blocks it towards mid on.
Bowls it on a length again, Scott Edwards defends it solidly.
Good length and down leg, Bas de Leede eases it to mid on for a quick single. Just 3 runs needed now.
On a length again, on off. Scott Edwards guides it to short third man for one.
FOUR! On a length and on off, Scott Edwards cuts it past backward point for a boundary and gets off the mark in style.

OUT! CAUGHT! A good knock comes to an end from Max O'Dowd and Milton Shumba takes a fine catch. Bowls it slightly shorter and on off, Max O'Dowd shuffles across and slaps it but doesn't connect well. The ball carries towards deep point and Milton Shumba gets under this one. Max O'Dowd departs but the job is almost done here for the Netherlands. Scott Edwards makes his way out to the middle.
Commentary.Howout: c Milton Shumba b Blessing Muzarabani

Commentary.Commentary: Fuller one this time, Max O'Dowd flicks it to square leg for one. They just need 9 runs now as 17 runs have come from this over.

FOUR! A low full toss again, outside leg. Max O'Dowd just gives it a fine tickle as the ball races away the fine leg fence for a boundary! That brings up the half-century for Max O'Dowd and he has played really well here.

FOUR! Poor fielding in the deep and that does not help Zimbabwe's cause! Luke Jongwe serves a low full toss on the pads that is clipped straight to the deep square leg fielder who gets behind it but allows it to slip through his hands and run away to the boundary. Just 14 runs needed now!
NO BALL! Luke Jongwe gets his slower ball all wrong as he bowls an above-waist beamer at the batter. Max O'Dowd is floored and the umpire calls this a no ball. We have a Free Hit coming up!
This is full and outside the off pole, Bas de Leede guides this to deep point for a single.
FOUR! Luke Jongwe has got his radar off here! He serves this on the pads as he goes fuller and Bas de Leede gets a tickle on this to fine leg for a boundary.
WIDE! Strays down leg once again on a shorter length, Bas de Leede is happy to leave this one alone as well and the umpire indicates it is wide.
WIDE! This is been banged in short but lacks direction as it does down leg side. The umpire calls this one wide.
Luke Jongwe bowls this on a good length and in line with the stumps. Bas de Leede gets squared up and gets a leading edge back down the pitch.
A low full toss served wide outside off, Max O'Dowd looks to heave but misses as just one run comes from this over with a wicket.
Richard Ngarava goes full and straight attacking the stumps, Bas de Leede clips this towards mid-wicket and takes a single to open his account.
Bas de Leede walks in.

OUT! CAUGHT! What are we witnessing here? The Netherlands are just 27 runs away from a win and they are giving away their wickets! Richard Ngarava bowls this a fraction full and outside off, Colin Ackermann looks to clear the infield on the off side but just slices this towards mid off. Luke Jongwe takes a really easy catch and Zimbabwe have two wickets in consecutive overs. They will defintely hope now!
Commentary.Howout: c Luke Jongwe b Richard Ngarava

Commentary.Commentary: Wide outside off on a fuller length, Colin Ackermann looks to swing but does not connect as the ball goes through to the keeper.
Bowls this in line with the stumps on a good length, Colin Ackermann tucks this towards mid-wicket.
Richard Ngarava bowls this on a good length and angling away from the right-hander outside off. Colin Ackermann blocks this towards cover.
Bowls this on a yorker length and just outside off, Colin Ackermann digs this ut towards mid on and takes one to get off the mark.
Colin Ackermann walks in next.

OUT! CAUGHT! Luke Jongwe breaks the partnership but it may be a little too late! He bangs this in short and outside off, Tom Cooper swivels and pulls this towards deep square leg where Wesley Madhevere runs to his right and takes a fine catch. He seems to have hurt his ankle though as his foot gets stuck in the turf. Nonetheless, the Netherlands lose their second wicket and Zimbabwe may still have some hope here.
Commentary.Howout: c Wesley Madhevere b Luke Jongwe

Commentary.Commentary: This is on a good length and outside the off pole, Max O'Dowd taps the ball towards point with soft hands and rushes for a run.

FOUR! Max O'Dowd does not want to stick around and wants to finish this in a hurry! Another full delivery served outside the off pole, Max O'Dowd lofts this over the mid off fielder and the ball trickles into the ripes at long off for four runs.
WIDE! Bangs this in short but going down leg side. Max O'Dowd looks to pull but misses and the umpire indicates a wide.
Continues bowling full and on the pads, Tom Cooper clips this to long on and takes a single.
Luke Jongwe starts off with full delivery angled into the stumps from outside off, Tom Cooper blocks this towards mid off.
Delivers this one really full and just outside off, Max O'Dowd looks to make room and stroke this to the boundary but finds the cover fielder.
On a good length and gets the ball to nip back in from outside off, Max O'Dowd gets an inside edge onto his pads and the ball falls down into the pitch.
Goes slightly fuller this time and outside the off stump, Max O'Dowd blocks this towards the point fielder.
A slower delivery bowled on a good length and outside the off stump, Tom Cooper waits on the ball and runs this down to third man for a run.
This is on a good length and outside off, Max O'Dowd guides this to third man and takes a single.
FOUR! This has been whipped away! Tendai Chatara bowls a gentle delivery full and into the pads, Max O'Dowd clips this wide of deep square leg and gets four runs more.
Bowls this one full and outside off, Tom Cooper heaves this to the leg side and just manages to clear the mid on fielder and collect two runs.
Fires this one a fraction full and angling down leg, Max O'Dowd looks to clip this but does not get bat to it and the ball goes to short fine leg for a leg bye.
This is on a good length and wide outside off, Tom Cooper guides this past the point fielder and picks up a single.
WIDE! Bangs this one in short and just outside off, Tom Cooper looks to pull at first but decides against it and this is called wide by the umpire for height.
Gets this closer to the off pole on a good length, Max O'Dowd taps this towards cover with soft hands and takes a quick single.
This is on a good length and outside the off stump, Tom Cooper slaps this to deep cover and takes a single.

LEG BYES! Blessing Muzarabani begins the over with a fullish delivery going down leg stump. Max O'Dowd looks to clip this fine but only manages to get the ball off his pads to fine leg for three extra runs.

DRINKS! The Netherlands have gotten off to a steady start despite losing Stephan Myburgh early and are well ahead of the required rate. The Zimbabwe pace bowlers have lacked penetration and they have resorted to spin options to try and restrict the scoring. They will be desperate to claim a few early wickets after the break while the Dutch will want to keep this partnership between Max O'Dowd and Tom Cooper going.
FOUR! Cheeky from Tom Cooper. Fuller and on off, Tom Cooper reverse paddles through third man for a boundary!
Outside off again, Max O'Dowd drives it to deep covers for one.
Touch fuller, on off. Tom Cooper drives it to covers for one.
Fuller one, on off. Max O'Dowd guides it to covers for one.
SIX! Up and over. Fuller and on off, Max O'Dowd lofts it over deep cover for a maximum. Excellent from Max O'Dowd!
Fuller and on off, Tom Cooper looks to drive it but miscues it to square leg for one.
Slightly shorter, on off. Tom Cooper looks to play at it but gets a top edge towards short third man. They collect one more.
On leg, Max O'Dowd knocks it to min on for one. Netherlands look happy with singles here!
Fuller and on off, Tom Cooper guides it to covers for one more.
Touch fuller this time, Max O'Dowd cuts it to backward point for one.
Back of a length again, on middle. Tom Cooper eases it to square leg for one again.
Slightly shorter and on leg, Max O'Dowd flicks it to mid-wicket for one.
Goes fuller, outside off. Tom Cooper smashes it over backward point for a brace.
On a length and just outside off, Max O'Dowd guides it to third man for one.
FOUR! Serves a slower one this time, Max O'Dowd lofts it over mid off for a boundary!
Bowls it fuller this time, Max O'Dowd works it to mid-wicket. Dot.
Back of a length again, Tom Cooper pulls it to mid-wicket for one.
Slightly shorter and on leg, Tom Cooper looks to pull it but the ball hits his ribs. Dot.
Quicker and on off, Tom Cooper guides it to covers for one.
Slightly shorter, Max O'Dowd knocks it to long on for one.
Full and on off, this is defended back towards te bowler.
Fuller and on leg, Tom Cooper looks to flick but gets his pads to backward square leg for a single. Leg bye.
Tossed up, down leg. Max O'Dowd eases it to short fine leg for one.
Tossed up, on off. Max O'Dowd eases it to the mid off fielder.

Good comeback from Blessing Muzarabani. On a length and outside off, Tom Cooper looks to play at it but misses. 10 runs off the over and the Netherlands are 35 for the loss of one wicket at the end of the Powerplay.
On a length and just outside off, Tom Cooper looks to slap it but doesn't connect well. Dot again.
Fuller and on off, Tom Cooper looks to scoop it but misses. It gets the lower part of his bat and rolls towards covers.
SIX! Tom Cooper has made up his mind now. Slightly shorter and on leg, Tom Cooper pulls it over deep mid-wicket for a maximum!
On a length and on leg, Tom Cooper looks to play at it but gets his pads.
FOUR! Good placement. Slightly shorter and just outside off, Tom Cooper cuts it and finds the gap between the point and cover for a boundary!
FOUR! This has been crunched away to the fence! Tendai Chatara bowls this outside the off stump on a good length, Max O'Dowd gets a hold of this one and thumps it to deep cover for four runs.
Induces an edge this time as he bowls this on outside off on a fuller length. Tom Cooper looks to play this into the off side but gets a thick edge to thrid man for a single.
This is a touch fuller and in angled into the stumps, Max O'Dowd taps this towards mid on and takes a quick single as the fielder stops the ball diving to his left.

Max O'Dowd looking slightly impatient at the crease now! Tendai Chatara bowls this on a good length and on an outside off stump line, Max O'Dowd charges down the wicket and looks to heave but gets beaten by the away movement.
This is on a good length and outside off, Max O'Dowd hits this firmly but straight to the extra cover fielder.

Tendai Chatara goes full and just outside off, Tom Cooper thumps this back towards the bowler who sticks his left hand out and parries it towards cover. They take a single and this could go down as a dropped chance but it was hit hard by the batter.
What a beauty! Blessing Muzarabani bowls this just outside the off pole and the movement away from a good length gets the batter feeling for the ball. He is beaten all ends up.
This is on a good length and outside off, Tom Cooper happy to work this to thrid man and get off the mark.
This is slightly short and wide outside off, Tom Cooper gets on top of the bounce and guides the ball towards gully.
Bowls this one a good length and just outside the off stump, Tom Cooper blocks this back towards the bowler.
Tom Cooper is the new batter.

OUT! CAUGHT! Zimbabwe draw first blood and as expected it is the impressive Blessing Muzarabani who gets the breakthrough! He goes a touch fuller this time and wide outside off, Stephan Myburgh looks to go for the expansive drive but ends up slicing this towards backward point. Ryan Burl does exceedingly well to clasp this ball over his head with both hands.
Commentary.Howout: c Ryan Burl b Blessing Muzarabani

Commentary.Commentary: Blessing Muzarabani bowls this back of a length and outside the off pole, Stephan Myburgh mistimes his pull to mid-wicket.
FOUR! Good length and outside off, Max O'Dowd punches it through covers for a boundary!
On a length and outside off, Max O'Dowd looks to play at it but misses again. Good bowling!
Fuller and outside off, Max O'Dowd drives it but finds the fielder at covers.
Bowls it outside off swinging it away, Max O'Dowd looks to play at it but misses again.
Nice movement on offer for Tendai Chatara as he serves this outside off on a good length, Max O'Dowd looks to drive but is beaten.
Shorter one and outside off, Max O'Dowd looks to play at it but misses.
Attacks the stumps once again on a good length, Stephan Myburgh defends this to into the pitch on the off side.
Short this time and outside off, Max O'Dowd mistimes his pull to the left of mid-wicket and they take a run.
This is in line with the stumps on a good length, Max O'Dowd blocks this to the cover fielder.

Goes back to bowling on a good length and outside the off pole, Stephan Myburgh taps the ball to the right of the point fielder who does well to dive and stop the ball. The batters look for a single and a direct hit at the non-striker's end would have sent Stephan Myburgh back to the shed.

SIX! Stephan Myburgh gets his first boundary now! Richard Ngarava pulls his length back and offers enough width for the batter to free his hands. Stephan Myburgh gets on his toes and lifts this over deep point for a maximum.
Richard Ngarava bowls this on a good length and outside the off stump, Stephan Myburgh blocks this towards point.
Richard Ngarava to bowl from the other end.
Lovely movement away from the batter this time! Tendai Chatara is hitting good lengths here as this ball goes past the outside edge once again.
This is closer to the off pole and still on a good length, Max O'Dowd hangs his bat out to dry and is beaten all ends up.
Bowls this on a good length as well and wide outside off, Max O'Dowd chooses to leave this one alone.

FOUR! Max O'Dowd is off the mark in style! Tendai Chatara bowls this outside the off pole on a good length, Max O'Dowd times this to perfection and finds the gap in the off side as the ball runs away to the deep point boundary for four runs.
This is on a good length as well and outside off, Max O'Dowd blocks this towards point.
Tendai Chatara begins with a good-length delivery on the pads, Stephan Myburgh clips this towards square leg and takes a single to get off the mark.
